title: hardening follow-ups: the overlay services and a pack that does not load (card H-58)
note: no container was started (no Docker daemon): the YAML of every stack and docker compose config of every stack were checked; H10G1-03 and H10G1-04 are fixed here and their state is set in container-hardening-2026-11-19/findings.json

findings.claim: the overlay services' written exceptions stay open (D-1337): llm-verifier read_only, user and cap_drop (closed with H10G1-02 on a GPU box), the rtx5090 swap helpers' user (the vLLM image's python runs as root), caddy's user and cap_drop (root on 443; the hospital's key file of an owner and mode the installer does not set), authelia's user, cap_drop and read_only (its entrypoint changes owners and user at start; it writes /app/.healthcheck.env), mailpit's read_only (its message database in /tmp)

the controls added to the overlay services that no CI job starts (authelia, prometheus, the platform doctor, the acceptance services, the test bench, the two-device link, the rtx5090 swap helpers) are shown only statically (YAML and docker compose config); each overlay is to be brought up on a compose box before they are trusted there

tests/unit/test_compose_limits.py lints no two-device compose file: its list of compose files globs deploy/ only (the platform file is added by name), so the link service's limits, log cap, health check and watchdog rule are not checked there
